title: An inline object anchored in the middle of a line
concept: A Rectangle written inside a CharacterStyleRange, between two Content elements, is an anchored object at that character position; with AnchoredPosition="InlinePosition" it sits in the line like a character as wide as the object.

annotations.note: The host run. The anchored object is a child of this CharacterStyleRange, not an item on the spread.
A Rectangle nested in the run is an anchored object, anchored at this point in the text. Its size comes from its PathGeometry, here 36 x 18 pt, as for any page item.
AnchoredObjectSetting says where the object goes. InlinePosition puts it in the line: it takes its width on the line and its bottom sits on the baseline, raised by AnchorYoffset.
The text after the anchor continues on the same line, after the object.
